assisted.name: Assisted pull-up
assisted.setup: Have staff demonstrate the assistance platform and safe entry/exit. More assistance makes the movement easier.
cues: Choose enough assistance for controlled reps.
Pull without swinging or shrugging.
Lower smoothly; stop with pain or tingling.

press.name: Machine chest press
press.setup: Adjust the seat so handles meet mid-chest. Keep feet planted and back supported.
cues: Keep wrists aligned with forearms.
Press smoothly without shrugging.
Return through a comfortable range.

row.name: Chest-supported row
row.setup: Adjust the chest pad and seat. Place feet securely and begin with a light load.
cues: Keep chest in contact with the pad.
Drive elbows back without shrugging.
Return slowly without jerking.

pulldown.name: Lat pulldown
pulldown.setup: Secure the thigh pad, plant feet, and choose a comfortable grip.
cues: Sit tall with a small natural lean.
Drive elbows downward toward your sides.
Return with control.

raise.name: Lateral raise
raise.setup: Use light dumbbells or a confirmed machine, with a relaxed grip.
cues: Keep elbows slightly bent.
Raise within a comfortable range.
Lower slowly, keeping shoulders away from ears.

pushup.name: Push-up
pushup.setup: Use a stable surface. Choose an incline if floor repetitions are too demanding.
cues: Keep head, torso, and hips aligned.
Brace gently and lower with control.
Press back up without hips sagging.

legpress.name: Leg press
legpress.setup: Set seat/backrest, learn safety stops, and place feet comfortably on the platform.
cues: Keep knees tracking in the direction of toes.
Lower only while pelvis and back remain supported.
Press smoothly without snapping knees straight.

squat.name: Squat to bench
squat.setup: Use a stable bench behind you. Start without external weight.
cues: Keep whole feet planted.
Bend hips and knees together.
Touch the bench gently and stand with control.

curl.name: Leg curl
curl.setup: Align knees with the machine pivot and position pads as its instructions show.
cues: Keep hips supported.
Bend knees smoothly.
Return slowly without lifting your hips.

bridge.name: Glute bridge
bridge.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, arms relaxed.
cues: Exhale and brace gently.
Lift hips until shoulders, hips, and knees align.
Lower without arching your lower back.

calf.name: Calf raise
calf.setup: Stand on a flat surface with light support for balance.
cues: Rise through the balls of your feet.
Pause briefly.
Lower heels slowly.

deadbug.name: Dead bug
deadbug.setup: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent. Start with legs only if needed.
cues: Breathe normally with a gentle brace.
Extend one leg only as far as your trunk stays still.
Return and alternate sides.

walk.name: Easy cardio
walk.setup: Choose walking or cycling at an intensity that permits conversation.
cues: Start easy and build gradually.
Use a comfortable pace.
Finish with a few easier minutes.

cablerow.name: Seated cable row
cablerow.setup: Use the low-pulley row station. Sit with feet supported and knees slightly bent. Choose a comfortable handle.
cues: Keep the trunk steady and wrists aligned.
Draw elbows back toward your sides.
Return slowly without rounding or rocking your back.
